stack.android_build: Android Gradle Plugin 8.11.1, Kotlin 2.2.20 (from the stable flutter create template)
stack.storage: Hive 2.2.3: box duonap_sleep_sessions (JSON string per session); box duonap_settings with key 'settings' (family settings) and key 'shift' (path setup, while one runs)

architecture: UI <-> ViewModel <-> Service <-> Repository. DTOs only in lib/data. Class prefix: DuoNap.
workflow: Solo project: finished phase branches are merged straight into main and pushed. No pull requests.
current_phase: Phase 2 built and merged into main. Phases 1 and 2 still need real days of use to meet their done criteria. Do not start Phase 3 (Firestore) without Loshi's go-ahead; it needs Firebase setup and approval for keys and rules.
recent_changes: Phase 2 shift plan (DuoNapShiftPlan, pure): started from the Rruga screen with the times in settings; every 3 days wake-up and bedtime move 15 min earlier; wake stops at 07:00, bedtime at the target (19:30 by default, 19:00/19:30/20:00 by hand); a step waits 2 days, re-checked, when the two evenings before it began more than 30 min late (later twin counts).

Phase 2 earlier night after a short night (DuoNapShortNight, per baby): typical night = median of the 7 nights before last night (at least 3); if last night was more than 45 min shorter, that baby's bedtime tonight moves earlier by half the shortfall, at most 45 min. Night or nap is now decided by the baby's own bedtime.
Phase 2 day boundary: a night that began after midnight, before 05:00, belongs to the evening before (LOGIC.md section 4).

Phase 2 Rruga screen ('D - Rruga 19-07' mockup): headline, progress segments, today's wake-up and bedtime, upcoming steps with dates, hold note, target sheet with stop. Header button on Today; settings shows a note instead of the time steppers while a path runs.
Refactors: DuoNapAnchors (a day's two times), DuoNapTodayInputs, shared duoNapMedian, shared DuoNapSheetFrame for bottom sheets, settings cards moved to their own file.

Tests: 93 passing (new: shift plan, short night, shift service, shift DTO, sleep service, after-midnight cases). flutter analyze clean. Checked on the Android 16 emulator: start, target change to 19:00, settings note, stop.
Phase 1 (merged): settings, 'woke up at...', edit and delete sheet, night view. Phase 0 (merged): first compile on Flutter stable.
current_tasks: Real use: a full day for Phase 1, and a few days with the path running for Phase 2.
Phase 3: Firestore sync between two phones (needs approval before any Firebase project, keys or rules).
Phase 4: notifications. Phase 5: history. Phase 6: optional AI logging and weekly summary.
open_decisions: Night vs nap by the clock: LOGIC.md says 'within 60 minutes of the planned bedtime'; the code counts any start from 60 minutes before bedtime until midnight as night (LOGIC.md section 7).
Changing the path's target mid-way re-reads earlier holds against the new target (LOGIC.md section 7).
Release builds: no INTERNET permission in the main AndroidManifest.xml, so google_fonts cannot download Sora outside debug builds. Add the permission or bundle the font.
A night split by night wake-ups is several sessions; the Nata row edits only the first.
The shared plan follows the first baby's lines; a sleep logged only for the second baby on a line the first has not logged cannot be opened from the plan yet.
A corrupt stored path record makes the Today screen show an error instead of falling back to settings; restarting the path from Rruga overwrites it.
Babies' exact age is unconfirmed; needed only for an age table for new users.
The 2 h 20 min minimum last wake window rests on one observation.
